_meta.conventions: Year label N = winter N-1/N (e.g. winter 2027 = winter 2026/27) for winter rows, summer N for summer rows. Company target reserve margins in GPC balance tables (24.6/25.1% winter, 18.6/19.1% summer) are the GPC-level equivalents of the system 26%/20% targets. basis: stated = figure appears in source; derived = arithmetic on sourced figures; estimated = judgement or scaling.
